Revenue categories for the same course period

Source: R/standard.R
course_revenue.Rd

One row per course, date, and frequency. Categories that the source does not report stay missing. A missing cart amount is not a measured zero. cart_green_fee_treatment records whether those two amounts are known to be separate. The default is "unknown", so a later ratio does not assume a bundled cart fee has already been removed from green fees.

Usage

course_revenue(
  course_id,
  date,
  frequency,
  green_fee = NA_real_,
  food_beverage = NA_real_,
  range = NA_real_,
  merchandise = NA_real_,
  cart = NA_real_,
  club = NA_real_,
  currency = "unknown",
  tax_treatment = "unknown",
  refund_treatment = "unknown",
  service_or_posting = "unknown",
  cart_green_fee_treatment = "unknown"
)

Arguments

course_id, date, frequency

Identifiers. frequency cannot mix day and month.

green_fee, food_beverage, range, merchandise, cart, club

Revenue amounts.

currency, tax_treatment, refund_treatment, service_or_posting

Source definitions. Unknown stays "unknown".

cart_green_fee_treatment

"separated", "bundled", "published_as_separate_categories", or "unknown".

Value

A golfops_course_revenue tibble.
